goal: Review Terraform code for state handling, provider versions, secrets, drift and blast radius.
use: Review Terraform code for state handling, provider versions, secrets, drift and blast radius. Use when infrastructure code is added or changed.

steps.note: Read the configuration. Open the root modules, variables, backend configuration and lock file.
Check state. State must live in a remote backend with locking and encryption.
Check versions. Providers and modules should be pinned.
Check secrets. Flag secrets in variables with defaults, in outputs, or written to state in plain text without need.
Check the blast radius. Large single state files affect many resources at once.
Report. List each finding with file and resource, severity and the fix.

protocol.title: Read the configuration
protocol.text: Open the root modules, variables, backend configuration and lock file.

protocol.title: Check state
protocol.text: State must live in a remote backend with locking and encryption. Flag local state.

protocol.title: Check versions
protocol.text: Providers and modules should be pinned. Flag unpinned or floating versions.

protocol.title: Check secrets
protocol.text: Flag secrets in variables with defaults, in outputs, or written to state in plain text without need.

protocol.title: Check the blast radius
protocol.text: Large single state files affect many resources at once. Note what one plan can change.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List each finding with file and resource, severity and the fix. Mark what a plan would need to confirm.
